newsitem.title: UK: Star-crossed almanac makes right royal blunder.
newsitem.headline: Star-crossed almanac makes right royal blunder.

text.p: Old Moore's Almanac, Britain's ancient annual of astrological predictions, got its stars badly crossed by predicting a split next year between Prince Charles and Princess Diana.
Charles and Diana were in fact divorced in August.
Publishers of the 300-year-old annual blamed the royal blunder in the new edition on a lapse of concentration by editorial staff.

"It's an old-fashioned cock-up", admitted managing editor Barry Belasco. He said predictions are prepared up to two years in advance and when going to print, staff overlooked the fact that the forecast had been overtaken by events.
